title: Choice principles in countable partition models
summary: We study the countable partition model over a set of atoms of arbitrary uncountable cardinality $κ$. Its supports are partitions of the atoms into countably many blocks, and a permutation fixes a support when it preserves each block setwise. This model was proposed by Bruce and studied by Banerjee. We prove that dependent choice holds for every $κ$, although the filter of subgroups is not closed under countable intersections.
